description: Source code defining the 'Stream' class and its methods for handling SPDY protocol streams in the 'spdystream' package, including data transmission, stream control, and header management.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: Represents a SPDY protocol stream, providing methods for data transfer, stream control, and header management.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes data to the stream, sending a data frame with optional fin flag.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes bytes to the stream, calling WriteData internally.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads bytes from the stream, retrieving data from the current unread buffer or data channel.

methods.name: ReadData
methods.description: Reads an entire data frame from the stream.

methods.name: waitWriteReply
methods.description: Waits for the stream to be ready to write a reply.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for the stream to receive a reply.

methods.name: WaitTimeout
methods.description: Waits for a reply with a timeout.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the stream by sending a final data frame with fin flag.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream, closing it fully.

methods.name: resetStream
methods.description: Internal method to send a reset frame and close the stream.

methods.name: CreateSubStream
methods.description: Creates a substream with the current stream as parent.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the stream.

methods.name: SendHeader
methods.description: Sends headers over the stream.

methods.name: SendReply
methods.description: Sends a reply headers on the stream, only once.

methods.name: Refuse
methods.description: Refuses the stream by sending a reset with refused status.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels the stream by sending a reset.

methods.name: ReceiveHeader
methods.description: Receives headers sent from the other side of the stream.

methods.name: Parent
methods.description: Returns the parent stream.

methods.name: Headers
methods.description: Returns the headers used to create the stream.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the stream, including streamId.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns a 32-bit identifier for the stream.

methods.name: IsFinished
methods.description: Checks if the stream has finished sending data.

methods.name: LocalAddr
methods.description: Returns the local network address.

methods.name: RemoteAddr
methods.description: Returns the remote network address.

methods.name: SetDeadline
methods.description: Sets the deadline for the underlying connection.

methods.name: SetReadDeadline
methods.description: Sets the read deadline for the underlying connection.

methods.name: SetWriteDeadline
methods.description: Sets the write deadline for the underlying connection.

methods.name: closeRemoteChannels
methods.description: Closes remote channels associated with the stream.
